parts.text:
You can sign in to your Microsoft account using the official links below. 

To ensure your account's security, **always verify that the URL in your browser's address bar starts with a secure Microsoft domain** before entering your password.

### 🔑 For Personal Accounts (Outlook, Hotmail, Xbox, OneDrive, Windows)
* **Official Microsoft Account Portal:** [account.microsoft.com](https://account.microsoft.com)
* **Direct Sign-In Page:** [login.live.com](https://login.live.com)

### 💼 For Work or School Accounts (Microsoft 365, Teams, Azure)
* **Work/School Sign-In Portal:** [login.microsoftonline.com](https://login.microsoftonline.com)
* **Microsoft 365 Home:** [microsoft365.com](https://www.microsoft365.com)

---

### ⚠️ Security Best Practices
* **Verify the URL:** Make sure the website address is exactly `https://login.live.com/...` or `https://login.microsoftonline.com/...` and has a lock icon next to the address.
* **Enable Two-Factor Authentication (2FA):** Protect your account by turning on two-step verification in your Microsoft security settings and using the **Microsoft Authenticator** app.
* **Never Share Your Password:** Microsoft will never ask for your password via email, text, or phone call.
